svg.title: A Prompt Change Is a Release
svg.desc: A life-cycle ring in which a claims-summary prompt change moves through build, an eval test and a canary deploy, and a failed eval sends it back to build before anything reaches production.
svg.text: A Prompt Change Is a Release
Mossgate Insurance: prompt v7 fails its eval, so it goes back to build.
NOTHING REACHES PRODUCTION BEFORE THE EVAL PASSES
